short_description.apollo:
GitLab is a public company based in San Francisco, California, founded in 2014. It operates as the developer of GitLab, an all-remote platform designed for DevSecOps. This platform helps teams and their AI agents deliver secure software more efficiently throughout the software lifecycle. GitLab has approximately 2,375 employees and is publicly traded on NASDAQ under the ticker symbol GTLB, with a market capitalization of around $7.31 billion.

GitLab offers a unified application that covers the entire DevSecOps lifecycle, including planning, building, securing, testing, deploying, and maintaining software. Key features include a core platform with version control, bug tracking, and task management, as well as integrated CI/CD, security scanners, and an AI solution called GitLab Duo Agent for automating tasks. The platform is available in both a free Community Edition and a proprietary Enterprise Edition, and can be deployed as self-managed software or as a SaaS solution. GitLab serves over 50 million registered users and more than 100,000 organizations globally, including many Fortune 100 companies.
